project.name: loop-factory podcast department — daily process
project.intent: Every 30 minutes: sense the estate, judge evidence against the charter, card the human, propose an allowlisted heal, prove the run itself. Nothing counts without a receipt; every failure has one road back to action.
project.evidence_basis: 2026-08-10 11:30 ET run artifacts in departments/podcast/state/ + podcast_daily.sh + procedural-graph.md + systemd user units

nodes.label: run-manifest MINT (kernel)
nodes.good: roster hash matches pinned release; run_id issued; all later records bind to it
nodes.qa: kernel checks roster hash vs pinned release before any node runs
nodes.on_fail: refusal = the run does not start (deny-by-default); dead chain caught by estate deadman <=26h

nodes.label: sense_estate
nodes.good: every charter estate unit present and ok, receipts fresh
nodes.qa: silent-gap guard: a unit missing from output fails the check
nodes.on_fail: non-ok row -> compare -> incident -> card

nodes.label: pipeline_sensor
nodes.good: counts from evidence, source fields logged per guest, never loop self-reports
nodes.qa: independence assertion; missing source => unknown, never assumed ok
nodes.on_fail: funnel_blind / funnel_behind incident -> card
nodes.reality: BLIND: sources/calendar.json absent; sole output is a missing-source row

nodes.label: publish_verifier
nodes.output: publishday observation checked at the provider (RSS/YouTube/social)
nodes.good: publish-day receipts verified by 10:30 ET, else explicit no-publish-due
nodes.qa: provider-level check; missing receipt = incident, never a warning
nodes.on_fail: exact missing-proof block -> incident -> card
nodes.reality: only no-publish-due branch observed live so far

nodes.label: manifest_sensor
nodes.good: every gap lists missing field + chase status + fallback y/n
nodes.qa: HubSpot(read)+episode state; unresolved identity => suppress + review
nodes.on_fail: gap -> expectation delta -> incident -> card

nodes.label: hopper_sensor
nodes.good: hopper depth + interview readiness meet objectives
nodes.qa: scans episodes hopper + publish schedule evidence directly
nodes.on_fail: shortfall -> funnel_behind -> incident -> card

nodes.label: funnel_floor_sensor
nodes.good: floors met, computed from FUNNEL-LEDGER evidence only
nodes.qa: missing ledger => every floor UNKNOWN, never assumed ok
nodes.on_fail: breach -> funnel_behind; blind gauge -> funnel_blind
nodes.reality: alarming today: new_outreach_this_week, hopper_depth 0 — mechanism working

nodes.label: floor_compiler_run (weekly)
nodes.good: floors derived from charter goals + matured cohort rates
nodes.qa: weekly gate; FREEZES on state drift / unledgered inbound / red verdict / malformed ledger
nodes.on_fail: every move or freeze is itself an alarm observation; goals stay human-only

nodes.label: expectation_reconcile
nodes.good: exit 0: all expectations met, deltas 0
nodes.qa: exit contract 0/2/1; || true bypass removed, pinned by test_daily_failclosed
nodes.on_fail: exit 2: findings judged THIS run; exit 1: chain stops

nodes.label: comms_reconcile_sensor
nodes.good: no open loop: upstream nonzero => downstream movement within 48h SLA
nodes.qa: receipt-gated: invalid/empty receipt HALTS the chain before judging
nodes.on_fail: findings -> judge; broken tracker stops the run fail-closed

nodes.label: dag_supervisor
nodes.good: fresh projection, hashes recompute clean, zero silent skips
nodes.qa: recomputes DAG + skip-artifact hashes; stale/missing = fail closed alarm
nodes.on_fail: dag_receipt_violation incident -> card; read-only lane, never schedules

nodes.label: compare_charter
nodes.good: every non-ok observation classified with setpoint + evidence path
nodes.qa: finite transition table, enumerable classes, no LLM
nodes.on_fail: crash stops chain fail-closed

nodes.label: fingerprint_dedup
nodes.good: one open thread per fingerprint
nodes.qa: dedup test: same fingerprint twice = ONE thread
nodes.on_fail: recurrence after resolve = department_defect escalation

nodes.label: escalate_outbox
nodes.output: escalation card in decisions_outbox.jsonl (eli5 + one question + evidence + fingerprint)
nodes.good: card complete, digest-deduped; shadow delivered_count==0 external
nodes.qa: card content check; digest markers fail closed
nodes.on_fail: unanswered >24h / stale >48h -> conductor re_escalate

nodes.label: run-manifest VERIFY (kernel)
nodes.good: green: 0 missing / duplicates / reordered / unexpected
nodes.qa: diff roster vs runs-v2 bound by LOOP_FACTORY_RUN_ID
nodes.on_fail: exit 2 advisory: manager warns today, judged next run; blocking flip = owner decision
nodes.reality: verdicts read ok,unsigned — signature not enforced

nodes.label: manager tick (factory)
nodes.output: MANAGER_BRIEF.md + heartbeats.jsonl + runs.jsonl + owner sends via outbox
nodes.good: findings empty or expected ramp; numbers inside ceilings
nodes.qa: deterministic Sense/Compare/Record vs charter; budget check vs budget_used.json
nodes.on_fail: red finding escalates to owner
nodes.reality: budget_telemetry_missing red every cycle: state/budget_used.json producer not wired for podcast

nodes.label: human_in_the_loop push
nodes.output: approval cards from approval_queue.jsonl into the outbox
nodes.good: queue drained, approvals in front of the owner
nodes.qa: queue/outbox accounting; brief counts approvals aged >1d
nodes.on_fail: aging approvals resurface in the brief every cycle

nodes.label: heal_select
nodes.output: playbook selection or recorded refusal -> heals.jsonl
nodes.good: fingerprint matches versioned playbook, or clean refusal — never improvise
nodes.qa: allowlist match only
nodes.on_fail: crash -> heal_failures.jsonl; incident stays open -> card

nodes.label: heal_apply
nodes.good: allowlisted commands only; invariants untouched
nodes.qa: allowlist enforcement; invariant touch = refuse
nodes.on_fail: failure row; chain continues; manager senses and drives the ladder
nodes.reality: restart of podcast-loop-production-publish proposed and FAILING repeatedly

nodes.label: heal_verify
nodes.good: re-sense proves incident cleared (consecutive healthy)
nodes.qa: heal without verified clearance = FAILED heal
nodes.on_fail: FAILED heal escalates; recurrence feeds root-cause C12

nodes.label: rotate_observations
nodes.good: retention bounded only after all consumers read
nodes.qa: hard line cap, runs after judging
nodes.on_fail: nonzero stops chain tail -> deadman

nodes.label: board render (estate)
nodes.good: boards rebuilt every run, mtime = last run
nodes.qa: render exit code inside the chain
nodes.on_fail: stale board = failed run tail -> deadman

nodes.label: conductor_tick (observer)
nodes.good: exactly one driver; decisions ordered unblock > floor_gap > routine
nodes.qa: exclusive lease (second claimant gets durable refusal); deadman 26h liveness
nodes.on_fail: dispatches NOTHING in shadow; stale/unanswered items queued re_escalate

nodes.label: Ankit (owner)
nodes.output: answers to cards, approvals, promotion decisions
nodes.good: cards answered inside 48h SLA; approvals not aging
nodes.qa: comms_reconcile checks the answer actually returned
nodes.on_fail: conductor re-escalates; brief counts aging approvals

nodes.label: estate deadman timer (26h)
nodes.good: silent
nodes.qa: independent systemd timer, hourly
nodes.on_fail: this IS the failure path — the watchdog for the watchdog

nodes.label: record.py
nodes.notes: in the graph as N9 but never invoked by the orchestrator; sensors emit their own records; deletion candidate

edges.carries: next run re-senses: cleared or re-escalate

open_questions: 48h comms-return SLA is a provisional default pending owner review
run-manifest verify blocking flip (advisory -> blocking) is an owner decision at P1 exit
conductor cutover from shadow ledger to live driving is an owner promotion decision
escalation delivery live (Telegram) is an unpromoted ladder step; cards stay local today
assumptions: states judged from the 2026-08-10 11:30 ET run artifacts; a green node can still carry a live business alarm — color is node health, not funnel health
no PHI/guest personal data included in this map; evidence paths only
